messages:
Priya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — IdentityGateway (IG) wants to pilot HSM + SSO + SCIM integration for a Private Marketplace listing. Need runbook, certs, and embargo plan. Who can take ownership of security checklist and infra certs? cc @Lena @Ethan @Marco @Tori
Ethan (security): I can own the security checklist. Key asks: HSM attestation, KMS integration pattern (proxy vs direct), SAML metadata exchange, and pentest scope. Need partner CSR and attestation docs.
Lena (solutions-eng): We can build the SI playbook and staging test harness. IG says their SCIM supports groups + custom attrs. Can someone confirm expected SCIM schema fields?
Marco (infra): From infra side: our Private deployments use the KMS forwarder v2. For HSM we need cert rotation details and latency SLOs — any constraints from IG? Also need a test HSM endpoint or emulator for staging.
Tori (marketing): FYI marketing wants an embargo window. We can prepare a co-announcement if pilot goes green. Need partner logo, legal review window, and a draft quote.
Priya (partnerships): Partner timeline: IG asked for a pilot next week. I pushed for 3‑week runway but they want earlier. Proposed owners + timeline: Security checklist (Ethan) — 3 days; Runbook + tests (Lena) — 1 week; Infra certs & staging (Marco) — needs CSR from partner by Wed; Marketing embargo/PR plan (Tori) — draft this week.
Ethan (security): I'll assemble a checklist and post the doc by EOD today. Quick items I'll include: HSM attestation, FIPS/crypto profile, SAML metadata verification, SCIM provisioning tests, vault access model, key-wrap vs proxy flow, and pentest schedule.
Lena (solutions-eng): Putting together a short test harness. Staging endpoint we can use: https://staging-ig.redwood-partners.example/svc (shared-secret via service account). Example SCIM call we'll exercise:```
curl -X POST "https://staging-ig.redwood-partners.example/scim/v2/Users" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $IG_TEST_TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"alice@example.com","name":{"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Example"}}'
```
Lena (solutions-eng): We'll also validate group sync and custom attribute mapping (department, cost_center).
Marco (infra): For certs: we need the partner CSR + chain by Wed to sign staging certs. Also confirm whether IG supports client cert auth for HSM e.g., mTLS. If they do, we need to provision client certs in our staging keystore.
Sam (identitygateway): Sam from IG here — we can produce CSR on Tue and provide SCIM payload examples. We support mTLS for HSM traffic and will share attestation report. Happy to join Tuesday sync.
Tori (marketing): Noted. Draft PR window suggestion: 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-22 contingent on pilot. Will prepare embargo checklist and PR boilerplate.
Priya (partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Security checklist (Ethan) 2) Integration runbook + test harness (Lena) 3) Infra config + cert signing (Marco) 4) Marketing embargo/PR draft (Tori) 5) Partner coordination + SI onboarding plan (Priya). Timeline: pilot kickoff next Tue, three-week pilot.
Ethan (security): I'll include required attestations and a pentest gate. Will add required metadata fields for SAML and SCIM in the doc.
Lena (solutions-eng): I'll create the playbook in the shared drive and invite a solutions SI contact for preflight.
Marco (infra): Noted — will prep certs and an HSM emulator if partner HSM isn't available immediately. If CSR missing by Wed we might delay signing.
Sam (identitygateway): We'll join the Tuesday sync and aim to upload CSR on Tuesday morning. We'll also share SCIM schema and a short test user CSV.
Priya (partnerships): Great — scheduling a 30m sync Tues 10:00am PT. I'll send calendar invite + agenda. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can make it or drop availability.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "IG pilot sync" Tue 10:00am PT — invitees: Priya, Ethan, Lena, Marco, Tori, Sam.
Marco (infra): :thumbsup:
Ethan (security): :thumbsup:
